translation.name: Biblica® Se aɖeke mebla Biblia zazã o Agbenya La™

content: Le ƒe si me Fia Uzia ku la, mekpɔ Aƒetɔ la wònɔ fiazikpui nyui kɔkɔ aɖe dzi, eye eƒe awutoga yɔ gbedoxɔ la katã me.
Serafi siwo aʋala ade li na la le etame. Wotsɔ aʋala eve tsyɔ ŋkume, eve tsyɔ woƒe afɔwo, eye wotsɔ eve bubu le dzodzomii.
Wodo ɣli ɖo ɖe wo nɔewo gbɔ be,

content.text: “Kɔkɔe, kɔkɔe, kɔkɔe nye Yehowa,
Dziƒoʋakɔwo ƒe Aƒetɔ la;
anyigba blibo la katã yɔ fũu
kple eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe.”

content: Woƒe gbe ƒe ɖiɖi na be ʋɔtrutiawo kple gbedoxɔ la ƒe agunu ʋuʋu, eye dzudzɔ yɔ gbedoxɔ la me taŋ.

Eye megblɔ be, “Alele! Evɔ nam azɔ, elabena nu vɔ̃ wɔla, nuyi makɔmakɔtɔ menye, eye mele dukɔ si ƒe nuyi mekɔ o, eye wonye vɔ̃wɔlawo la dome; evɔ la, metsɔ nye ŋkuwo kpɔ Fia, Yehowa, Dziƒoʋakɔwo ƒe Aƒetɔ la.”
Kasia Serafiawo dometɔ ɖeka dzo yi ɖe vɔ̃samlekpui la gbɔ, eye wòtsɔ abɛ tsɔ dzoka xɔxɔ le vɔsamlekpui la dzi hedzo va gbɔnye.
Etsɔ dzoka xɔxɔ la tɔ nye nuyi hegblɔ be, “Kpɔ ɖa, woɖe wò vodadawo ɖa, eye wotsɔ wò nu vɔ̃wo ke wò, elabena dzoka sia ka wò nuyi ŋuti.”
Eye mese Aƒetɔ la ƒe gbe wòbia be, “Ame ka madɔ, eye ame ka ayi na mí?” Meɖo eŋu be, “Aƒetɔ, nyee nye esi, dɔm!”

content.text: “Yi nàgblɔ na ame siawo be,
‘Miaƒe towo ase nyawo, gake miase egɔme o.
Miaƒe ŋkuwo akpɔ nu,
gake miele si dze gee o.’
Na dukɔ sia ƒe dzi naku atri,
tu woƒe towo, eye nàmia woƒe ŋkuwo.
Ne menye nenema o la,
woava kpɔ nu kple woƒe ŋkuwo,
ase nu kple woƒe towo,
ase nu gɔme kple woƒe dziwo,
eye woatrɔ akpɔ dɔyɔyɔ.”

content: Eye megblɔ bena “Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi, O! Aƒetɔ?” Eɖo ŋu be,

content.text: “Va se ɖe esime duwo katã zu aƒedo,
eye ame aɖeke megale wo me o.
Va se ɖe esime aƒewo katã naɖi gbɔlo,
eye anyigba la katã nazu gbegbe.
Va se ɖe esime Yehowa nya ame sia ame ɖo ɖe aboyome,
eye anyigba la katã nagblẽ keŋkeŋkeŋ.
Togbɔ be ameawo ƒe akpa ewoliawo dometɔ ɖeka
asusɔ ɖe anyigba dzi hã la,
woagana wòazu gbegbe,
gake abe ale si ne wolã logoti
kple gboti, takpoawo susɔna ene la,
nenema ke atiku kɔkɔe la azu
atitakpo ɖe anyigba la dzi.”
